title: CommitMint
tagline: Smart contracts for relationships built with love on ethereum for the web3jam
description: _Commitmint_ is a smart contract platform built for relationships. Our smart contracts are NFTs (Non-fungible tokens) built for two to establish permanent tokens of commitment, friendship and love. It takes two to "mint" (create) a token and two to "burn" (reject) a token, with varying terms for each activity.
how_its_made: _Commitmint_ is a smart contract platform built for relationships. Our smart contracts are NFTs (Non-fungible tokens) built for two to establish permanent tokens of commitment, friendship and love. It takes two to "mint" (create) a token and two to "burn" (reject) a token, with varying terms for each activity. This is made with love for tech and the spirit of cooperation. That being said, hardhat for the contract tooling, openzepplin ERC-721 base contracts, waffle for testing, react for the front-end. No sponsored tech was used.
